trial_name: Semaglutide Effects on Cardiovascular Outcomes in People With Overweight or Obesity

primary_publication.citation: Lincoff AM et al. Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Obesity without Diabetes. N Engl J Med 2023;389:2221-2232
primary_publication.selection_criterion: Reports the pre-specified primary outcome of the registered trial.

condition: overweight or obesity with established cardiovascular disease, without diabetes; age 45 years or older, body-mass index 27 or greater
design: multicentre, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled, event-driven superiority trial

statistical_analysis_plan.design: group-sequential, with a planned interim superiority analysis of the primary outcome at two thirds of the planned events (817 of 1225)
statistical_analysis_plan.alpha_control: overall one-sided type I error controlled at 2.5%, equivalent to 5% two-sided. A separate alpha-spending function was used for the confirmatory secondary endpoints (Lan-DeMets approach, per Glimm et al. 2010).
statistical_analysis_plan.gatekeeping: Confirmatory secondary endpoints are tested in a fixed hierarchical sequence after superiority on the primary. Testing stops at the first endpoint that fails to reach its nominal significance level; all subsequent endpoints in the sequence are not formally tested.
hierarchy: heart failure composite: death from cardiovascular causes, hospitalisation or urgent visit for heart failure
statistical_analysis_plan.threshold_note: 0.02314 in the statistical analysis plan. The value derives from alpha already spent across the sequential design and depends on the number of events accrued at final analysis; it is not 0.05.

outcomes.measure: first major adverse cardiovascular event: death from cardiovascular causes, non-fatal myocardial infarction, or non-fatal stroke, time to first event

outcomes.outcome_of_test: did not reach the nominal threshold of 0.023 required at this position; the hierarchical sequence stops here

outcomes.measure: heart failure composite: death from cardiovascular causes, hospitalisation or urgent visit for heart failure
outcomes.outcome_of_test: falls after the failed endpoint in the sequence; no formal hypothesis test performed and no confirmatory p value assigned. Reported as point estimate and 95% confidence interval, not adjusted for multiplicity.

falls after the failed endpoint in the sequence; no formal hypothesis test performed and no confirmatory p value assigned. Reported as point estimate and 95% confidence interval, not adjusted for multiplicity.

adverse_events.scope_declaration: The trial used targeted safety data collection: serious adverse events, adverse events leading to permanent discontinuation, and pre-specified events of special interest were recorded systematically. This is not a complete record of all adverse events. A summary generated from this table cannot report overall adverse event frequency beyond these categories.
adverse_events.p_value_note: The source reports p values for adverse event comparisons. These are descriptive safety comparisons, not part of the confirmatory hierarchy.
